entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hi, thanks for calling VeloFit support. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hello Sarah. I'm calling about an order I received. I'm just... so disappointed. I was really looking forward to my new jersey.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's the fit. I always order a large, but this jersey is just way too tight across the chest. It feels like the wrong size entirely. I've been a loyal customer for so long and I saved up for this... I just feel so let down that I can't even wear it.
I can definitely understand that frustration. Getting an item you're excited about and having it not fit is never a good feeling. It sounds like you just need a different size to be comfortable.
Exactly. I was hoping I could maybe exchange it? I really need the money back if I can't get one that fits.

Of course. The good news is that you are well within our 90-day return policy for apparel. We can absolutely process an exchange for a different size at no extra cost to you. I can get that started right away.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. An XL would be perfect.

I'm happy to help. I have just initiated the exchange in our system and sent a prepaid return label to the email we have on file. Once you send the original jersey back, we'll ship out the XL immediately. Does that sound good?
That sounds wonderful. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've really helped me out.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day!
